evidence: decorative_mascot: hook@0.3 to seg0:end and seg3:start to seg3:end: Data just stands on top of a growing circle with no action tied to the stat. In seg2:start to seg2:end two copies of him stand side by side cheering, which reads as a copy glitch, not a bit.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start to seg2:end: two identical Data figures cheer at once. One covers the 'Before 2014' label so it reads 'Before 201'. The '10.1K%' is a number sliding along a line with a dotted rail, and nothing grows or explodes.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic two-row value slide was used for a population explosion. A mascot was placed on each row, so Data is duplicated and overlaps the axis label, and the 100x growth is only printed as text.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the urchin explosion physically: a small cluster of purple urchins multiplies roughly 100x until it floods the frame. Use one Data, reacting to (or buried by) the swarm, and keep every label clear of the mascot.
